{"notes": "VISIT 4 (ended 6:00). Picture: body, nose and both tail lobes are dark and connected. The fin runs dark up to about (18,3.4). A small pale grey domino remains near (13.4,4.8), probably the jammed piece Tom mentioned. I can't tell who placed what, so I'm not crediting anyone for the build itself.

Tom: Said he's re-laying the fin from the top line so the jam goes with it. Asked for hands off the corner and promised to check the joint himself. Strong ownership and clear communication. He hasn't yet confirmed the fin catches, and the stray pale piece is still there. He has now owned this fault across two visits, so I'll judge on whether it lands before the push.

Priya: Backed Tom's plan, told everyone to keep hands off the body, and set up the final check once the fin catches. Good coordination and process discipline. I still don't know what she built, especially the nose join. Ask her.

Maya: Tom thanked her, which suggests she flagged the jam, but I didn't hear that myself. She said she's keeping clear and will shout if the joint fails, which is cooperative and supports the team. Still no visible evidence of what she built. Ask her directly before rating impact.

Leo: Not seen or heard this visit. Earlier status reporting and 'hands off' coordination were strong. No new evidence.

NEXT: Confirm the fin tip is dark and connected and the stray is cleared before the push. Ask Priya and Maya what they each built."}
